meta.source: Indicative figures blended from public sources (GuruFocus, StockAnalysis, Simply Wall St, Stockopedia, Kalkine, company results) as researched on 2026-09-10. P/E, yield and payout vary by source and methodology (trailing vs forward, and whether special dividends are counted). Not live — regenerate with screener.py for current data.
meta.disclaimer: General information only, not financial or investment advice. Figures are indicative and may be stale or revised. Dividend yield and payout ratio are shown as additional context, not as screening criteria. A payout ratio above 100% means the dividend exceeds earnings and may not be sustainable. Verify against a live source and consider your own circumstances before making any decision.

stocks.name: Charter Hall Retail REIT
stocks.note: Convenience and supermarket-anchored centres. Lowest multiple on the screen, with the payout comfortably covered.

stocks.name: Helia Group
stocks.note: Lenders mortgage insurer. Headline yields near 22% appear when special dividends are counted — the ordinary yield is ~6%. New business is shrinking.

stocks.name: HomeCo Daily Needs REIT
stocks.note: Daily-needs retail landlord. Payout far exceeds earnings — REIT distributions are paid from cash flow, but check coverage.

stocks.name: GQG Partners
stocks.note: Capital-light funds manager, high cash conversion. The very high yield reflects a fallen share price; sources quote 10–14% and payout is ~94%.

stocks.name: Dexus
stocks.note: Office, industrial and funds management. Free-cash-flow yield ~10% and the best-covered payout on the list.

stocks.name: Waypoint REIT
stocks.note: Landlord of service-station property on long leases — a property business, not an energy one, so it clears the resources filter.

stocks.name: GrainCorp
stocks.note: Grain handling and processing. Earnings swing with the harvest, and the payout currently exceeds earnings.

stocks.name: GPT Group
stocks.note: Office, retail and logistics REIT trading below net tangible assets.

stocks.name: Region Group
stocks.note: Neighbourhood and convenience retail landlord with steady rents and a rising distribution history.

stocks.name: Qantas Airways
stocks.note: Strong operating cash flow, but free cash flow swings with fleet capex. Dividend resumed recently, fully franked.

stocks.name: Harvey Norman
stocks.note: Just above the P/E<10 line on trailing earnings; passes if you widen the threshold.

stocks.name: Stockland
stocks.note: Residential and retail REIT; narrowly above the P/E cutoff.

stocks.name: Seven West Media
stocks.note: Above the cutoff and pays no dividend at present.

stocks.name: Eagers Automotive
stocks.note: Re-rated well above the cutoff; payout supported by cash flows.

stocks.name: Growthpoint Properties
stocks.note: High yield but earnings-based P/E is far above the cutoff.
